about: The Mexican peso's settlement calendar (Mexico City): the days the CNBV requires supervised financial entities to close, 1990-2100 (its yearly 'DISPOSICIONES de carácter general que señalan los días del año ... en que las entidades financieras ... deberán cerrar sus puertas y suspender operaciones', in the DOF). January 1; Constitution Day, Benito Juárez's birthday and Revolution Day, on the first Monday of February, the third Monday of March and the third Monday of November from 2006 (the 2005 reform of the Ley Federal del Trabajo) and on February 5, March 21 and November 20 before; Holy Thursday and Good Friday; May 1; September 16; November 2; December 12 (the bank employees' day); December 25; and the presidential inauguration every six years (December 1 to 2018, October 1 from 2024). A holiday on a weekend isn't moved, and two on one day are one day. Checked against the CNBV's 2024 list (DOF, 2023-12-12) and its 2026 list (DOF, 2025-12-10, as reported); other years are the rules unchecked against a published list.
